show: There's always something between the cracks
name: Danai Belosinof
description:
Installation for multichannel speaker choir, sand & light.

An immersive dive into the fabric of a brick wall: as we zoom into the re-imagined universe of the minuscule molecular motions within bricks, following their path into corrosion by the natural forces of water, sun & wind.

Houses - we build houses
Rocks - rocks put together
Houses of protection
Houses that house us
Houses that defy time
Stiff - to conquer the wind
Floating - to conquer the waters
More houses and more houses and cemented gardens
And then the sea smiles and she swallows the houses.
bio: Danai Belosinof (1993, GR/BG) is an Amsterdam-based composer & multidisciplinary maker with sound as her primary medium. She studied composition focusing on Karnatic rhythm techniques and Javanese gamelan. She composes and creates interdisciplinary performances with sound at their core. She uses subjects inspired by everyday life or natural processes & brings them on stage as immersive interdisciplinary situations. In particular, she investigates the subjectivity of our perception of reality, time & space and ways in which sound can sculpt it, the function of human voice and language and music as an expression of primitivism in humans. Often her music incorporates subtle humour and surreal storytelling, as tools that contribute to experiencing different realities through sound in a constant wish to alleviate reality's heaviness. Her works have been presented in venues such as Stichting Sign, the Eye FilmMuseum, MA/IN festival, the Greek National Opera, OnassisStegi Foundation
